name: flickering-text
title: Flickering Text
description: Deterministic per-character text flicker with adjustable correlation and optional glow bloom.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Glow color when bloom is enabled.

props.name: wigglesPerSecond
props.description: Noise samples per second that drive the flicker.

props.name: correlation
props.description: How much each character follows the shared flicker lane.

props.name: minOpacity
props.description: Lowest opacity characters can dip to.

props.name: minAmount
props.description: Lower bound of the flicker selector.

props.name: maxAmount
props.description: Upper bound of the flicker selector.

props.name: glowIntensity
props.description: Glow strength when bloom is enabled.

props.name: glow
props.description: Turns the extra glow effect on or off.
